- **self**: Aave v3 and v4 risk parameters and health factor math (2/2)

## How it works

- [statement] Both v3 and v4 return type(uint256).max as the health factor when an account has no debt (v3 also returns it for an empty user configuration). Integrations that read the health factor must treat max uint as 'no debt', not as a large finite value. (high confidence) — https://github.com/aave-dao/aave-v3-origin/blob/main/src/contracts/protocol/libraries/logic/GenericLogic.sol · keywords: Aave v3 and v4 risk parameters and health factor math · also: https://github.com/aave/aave-v4/blob/main/src/spoke/Spoke.sol

## Measurements and reference values

- [statement] Aave v3 health factor is the liquidation-threshold-weighted collateral value divided by total debt value: HF = Σ(collateral_value_i × LT_i) / Σ(debt_value_j). A position with HF below 1 can be liquidated. Aave's own example: $10,000 of ETH at an 80% liquidation threshold with $6,000 of GHO borrowed gives HF 1.333. Aave Governance sets the liquidation threshold per collateral asset. (high confidence) — https://aave.com/help/borrowing/liquidations · keywords: Aave v3 and v4 risk parameters and health factor math · also: https://github.com/aave-dao/aave-v3-origin/blob/main/src/contracts/protocol/libraries/logic/GenericLogic.sol, https://updraft.cyfrin.io/courses/aave-v3/contract-architecture/health-factor
